scope: Optional read-only host IDE transfer and native memory/mapped-file diagnostics; no benchmark acceptance or Win98 cache root-cause claim.

controls.disk: Original 470748903-byte DAT remains unchanged; read-only base image with RAM overlay.
controls.observer: Hash overlapping game-disk callbacks and the real post-write ordinary RAM bytes; retain payload, error, callback order and other CPUs. No guest PTE edits, CPU watch arming, injected IRQ or clock changes.
controls.bounds: 262144 NDJSON records maximum, with dropped/loggingErrors counters. Mapped hold only in an explicit standalone build, limited to 0..60000ms; default0.

validation.unit: node tests/devices/geforce_ide_watch.mjs: asynchronous/nested callbacks, source identity/options/returns, source offsets, DMA return/exception identity, other CPU isolation, hook restoration and logging failure.
validation.build: Strict freestanding MinGW -Wall -Wextra -Werror: native memory watcher and mapped-hold file checker; harness syntax passes.

native.environment: Cold Win98 81.98 with production WP-fixed CPU and IDE task-file/block-progress fixes. Native helper runs separately before original 03, 256MiB RAM.
native.memoryWatcher: At least7 normal one-minute samples written with GlobalMemoryStatus, GetTickCount and C free clusters. No memory-pressure conclusion from desktop-only samples.

limits: This fresh 1MiB read/write case passes. It does not establish why prior post-GT2 states had corrupt cached source pages or inconsistent mapped-copy output.
Observer hashing/logging and the separate native helper add host/guest work, so this run is diagnostic and does not supply a release FPS gate.
Original full Win98 03 still requires a successful run and result export.
evidence: build/nv40-win98-mark03-ide-fixed-cold-io-watch; held mapping coherent checkpoint and pre-run desktop checkpoint losslessly archived with verified decompressed SHA256; paired overlays/bundles retained.
